blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ لَقِيَ اللهَ بِغَيْرِ أَثَرٍ مِنْ جِهَادٍ لَقِيَ اللهَ وَفِيهِ ثُلْمَةٌ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث غريب، باب ما جاء في فضل المرابط، رقم:١٦٦٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “If a person comes to Allah Ta'ala without any mark of having striven in the path of Allah Ta'ala, he will meet Allah Ta'ala with a deficiency in himself (in his Deen).”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The mark of striving means the scar of some wound on his body received while going in the path of Allah Ta'ala, or marks on the body caused by the dust of the path of Allah Ta'ala, or by service, and the like.
(Sharh at-Tibi)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ ﵁ يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: مَقَامُ أَحَدِكُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ سَاعَةً خَيْرٌ لَهُ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ عُمُرَهُ فِي أَهْلِهِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Suhail (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say, “One of you standing for a little while in the path of Allah Ta'ala is better than the good deeds he does his whole life while staying in his home.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵄ قَالَ: بَعَثَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ عَبْدَ اللهِ بْنَ رَوَاحَةَ فِي سَرِيَّةٍ فَوَافَقَ ذلِكَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ، فَغَدَا أَصْحَابُهُ فَقَالَ: أَتَخَلَّفُ فَأُصَلِّيْ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ اَلْحَقُهُمْ، فَلَمَّا صَلَّي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ رَآهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ:
